pro_course_detail.title: Conversation practice/ Text correction
pro_course_detail.description:
Please read the *policy* before booking a lesson.

CONVERSATION PRACTICE LESSONS are meant for students at level A2 or higher. 

If you are a beginner or lower intermediate (A2-B1), we will practice easy conversations in Slovene. We will start with basic questions like "What are your hobbies?" or "What is your favourite food?" and practice simple everyday situations like ordering in a restaurant or asking for directions. My goal in this class is to help you overcome the fear of speaking Slovene. I will help you to come out of your comfort zone. Together we will build easy sentences and expand your vocabulary. 

If you are higher intermediate or advanced (B2-C2) I usually prepare conversation topics, pictures or articles for us to talk about, but you can also decide to talk about something else. We can discuss news, books, movies, food or just talk about our day-to-day lives. The important thing here is practice. The more exposure to the language the better! ;)

TEXT CORRECTION LESSONS are lessons where we look through your text and correct the grammar mistakes. If you want, this lesson can also be without zoom. You book the lesson and send me the document to correct. After the lesson is complete, I’ll send you the corrected version with notes on how to improve and other suggestions. If you want, I can also give you writing tasks based on your level, which you can then send back to me for correction.

If you have any questions please feel free to send me a massage.

*Policy*
- Cancellation with more than 12 hours' notice gets you a full refund.
- If you give notice less than 12 hours before and can't make it, you'll receive a 50% refund.
- If you're more than 15 minutes late without prior notice, the lesson will be canceled without a refund.
- Just a heads up, I focus on teaching adults and don't offer lessons for children.
